sample_unit: search queries (each input to four chatbots)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses relative to recommended consumer health information reading level
links.effect: Responses were written at a fairly difficult reading level and exceeded the reading level recommended for consumer health information.
links.quote: AI chatbots produce information that is generally accurate and of moderate to high quality in response to the top urological malignancy-related search queries, but the responses lack clear, actionable instructions and exceed the reading level recommended for consumer health information.

links.outcome: Understandability, actionability, and readability of chatbot outputs for patients
links.effect: Median PEMAT-P understandability 66.7% (range 44.4-90.9%); median actionability 40% (range 0-40%); fairly difficult reading level.
links.quote: Understandability was moderate (median Patient Education Material Assessment Tool for Printable Materials [PEMAT-P] understandability 66.7%, range 44.4-90.9%) and actionability was moderate to poor (median PEMAT-P actionability 40%, range 0-40%The responses were written at a fairly difficult reading level.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating the quality, readability, and actionability of multiple LLM chatbot responses to patient search queries regarding urological malignancies.
